groups.problem: The migration inserts legacy hosts without stripping schemes and paths, so migrated hosts fail hostname lookups.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same raw INSERT bypassing model normalization and describe the same resulting lookup failure.

groups.problem: The migration dereferences an empty category lookup result before it can use the uncategorized fallback.
groups.rationale: Both report the unchecked first row of the embed_category query. S5's additional fallback guard appears only in its proposed fix.

groups.problem: Host actions dereference potentially missing records without handling unsuccessful lookups.
groups.rationale: Both report the unchecked lookup in destroy; S11 also identifies the identical mistake in update. These are repeated instances of the same missing-record handling pattern.

groups.problem: The embedding serializer emits host IDs without the sideloaded records required by client hydration.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same association serialization setting and the resulting unresolved host objects on the admin page.

groups.problem: Host normalization calls sub! on nil before validation can return an ordinary error.
groups.rationale: Both report the same unconditional mutation in before_validation and the same omitted-host request trigger.

groups.problem: The blank-host example passes because of other false conditions and no longer tests the condition named in its description.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same misleading test and missing setup, with equivalent suggestions to rename it or exercise its stated precondition.
